why: The oversize run writes garbage before its hello, so it dies at spawn and the oversized frame is never requested and never sent. What this mutant guards is the ATTRIBUTION: the run's fixture expects OversizeFrame, and crediting that expectation to a run which aborted on a prerequisite would let a coverage claim be paid for by a stimulus nobody ever sent. The kind this run establishes is the one the host actually reported on the way down -- PreHelloOutput -- and a declaration of OversizeFrame here must not type-check as coverage.
